<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913707_theRebbe_562" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913707_theRebbe_562__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "Yivchar Lanu" is connected to the shofar blowing and represents G-d's choice of Israel from His own essence, beyond the reach of arousal from below.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Now, from the fact that before the shofar blast they recite</t>
    <t s="1">(not only this verse,</t>
    <t s="2">but)</t>
    <t s="3">the entire psalm,</t>
    <t s="4">it is understood</t>
    <t s="5">that all the verses of the psalm are related to the matter of rising from the Throne of Judgment and sitting on the Throne of Mercy, which occurs through the shofar blast.</t>
    <t s="6">And all the more so the verse "Yivchar Lanu" which is adjacent to the verse "Alah Elokim B'Teruah,"</t>
    <t s="7">indicating</t>
    <t s="8">that this verse is connected to "Alah Elokim B'Teruah."</t>
    <t s="9">And it must be understood,</t>
    <t s="10">that the matter of "Yivchar Lanu" is that the Holy One's choice of Israel is from His own essence</t>
    <t s="11">(and not that the service of Israel arouses Him to choose them),</t>
    <t s="12">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="13">the matter of choice is</t>
    <t s="14">in the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="15">where the concept of arousal from below does not apply.</t>
    <t s="16">That is to say,</t>
    <t s="17">in addition to the fact that the actual choice is from His own essence and not aroused by arousal from below,</t>
    <t s="18">rather, in this place</t>
    <t s="19">(where the matter of choice is)</t>
    <t s="20">it is entirely impossible to arouse through arousal from below.</t>
    <t s="21">And the matter of "Alah Elokim B'Teruah" is,</t>
    <t s="22">that the shofar blast of Israel arouses that He rise from the Throne of Judgment and sit on the Throne of Mercy.</t>
    <t s="23">And from the adjacency of the two verses it is implied that the two matters are related to each other.</t>
    <t s="24">That is to say,</t>
    <t s="25">that by Israel taking their shofars and blowing before the Holy One, they draw down not only the mercy that is aroused through service</t>
    <t s="26">(arousal from above that is aroused by arousal from below),</t>
    <t s="27">but through this they also draw down the mercy</t>
    <t s="28">that stems from the Holy One's choice of Israel,</t>
    <t s="29">"Yivchar Lanu."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the shofar blast on Rosh Hashanah draws down from the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof to build the aspect of Malchus with desire and pleasure, as the world is in a state of faintness before this.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And it may be added,</t>
    <t s="2">that the above matter</t>
    <t s="3">(that by Israel blowing the shofar they also draw down the matter of the choice of the Awtsmoos, where it is impossible to arouse through arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="4">is also understood from what is known</t>
    <t s="5">that the essential</t>
    <t s="6">matter of Rosh Hashanah is the building of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="7">as the Sages said,</t>
    <t s="8">"Recite before Me [verses of] Kingship so that you make Me King over you."</t>
    <t s="9">And what they said,</t>
    <t s="10">"The mitzvah of the day is with the shofar,"</t>
    <t s="11">is because the matter of "you make Me King over you" is through the shofar blast,</t>
    <t s="12">as follows from the above statement of the Sages, "And with what? With the shofar."</t>
    <t s="13">And the connection of Rosh Hashanah to the building of Malchus</t>
    <t s="14">(simply)</t>
    <t s="15">is,</t>
    <t s="16">because on Rosh Hashanah is the renewal of the act of Creation.</t>
    <t s="17">As we say,</t>
    <t s="18">"This day is the beginning of Your works,"</t>
    <t s="19">for on every Rosh Hashanah all the worlds are brought into being</t>
    <t s="20">anew, as they were the first time.</t>
    <t s="21">And the matter is,</t>
    <t s="22">that the coming into being of all the worlds is from the attribute of His Kingship.</t>
    <t s="23">And the drawing down of Malchus on every Rosh Hashanah</t>
    <t s="24">(including also the first Rosh Hashanah at the beginning of Creation)</t>
    <t s="25">is only for one year,</t>
    <t s="26">and on the eve of Rosh Hashanah at nightfall</t>
    <t s="27">it returns and ascends and is absorbed into its source.</t>
    <t s="28">However, the ascent and removal is only in the inwardness of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="29">which is the delight and will within Malchus.</t>
    <t s="30">And the vitality of the world on Rosh Hashanah</t>
    <t s="31">(even before the matter of "you make Me King over you")</t>
    <t s="32">is from the externality of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="33">analogous to a person who does work when he is tired and weak-handed, having no delight in it.</t>
    <t s="34">And as per the well-known saying,</t>
    <t s="35">that on the night of Rosh Hashanah</t>
    <t s="36">(before the matter of "you make Me King over you")</t>
    <t s="37">the world is in a state of fainting.</t>
    <t s="38">And this is [the meaning of] "Recite before Me [verses of] Kingship so that you make Me King over you,"</t>
    <t s="39">that He should have will and delight in the kingship.</t>
    <t s="40">And it is known</t>
    <t s="41">that the removal on Rosh Hashanah is in all levels</t>
    <t s="42">(action,</t>
    <t s="43">speech,</t>
    <t s="44">thought,</t>
    <t s="45">emotions and intellect),</t>
    <t s="46">for all things return to their original state.</t>
    <t s="47">And the drawing down of Malchus</t>
    <t s="48">(will and delight in the kingship)</t>
    <t s="49">on Rosh Hashanah is by drawing from the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="50">And from the fact that the matter of "you make Me King over you" is through the shofar blast as above,</t>
    <t s="51">it is understood</t>
    <t s="52">that the shofar blast reaches the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section raises the question of how the shofar blast, a mitzvah given by the King, can be used to make Him King, and concludes that the shofar has two aspects: the mitzvah and the reaching of the Awtsmoos beyond the aspect of King.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it must be understood,</t>
    <t s="1">but the shofar blast is a mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="2">and the matter of commandments</t>
    <t s="3">(mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="4">applies specifically after He has become King,</t>
    <t s="5">as the statement,</t>
    <t s="6">"Accept My Kingship first, and then I will decree decrees upon you,"</t>
    <t s="7">and in order for there to be "you make Me King over you"</t>
    <t s="8">(that Israel make Him King)</t>
    <t s="9">it is by reaching the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof as it is before</t>
    <t s="10">(above)</t>
    <t s="11">He became King,</t>
    <t s="12">so how is it possible that through the shofar blast</t>
    <t s="13">(the fulfillment of the mitzvah and command of the King)</t>
    <t s="14">they make Him King?</t>
    <t s="15">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="16">that in the shofar blast there are two matters,</t>
    <t s="17">the mitzvah of the shofar blast,</t>
    <t s="18">and this [other matter] that through the shofar blast they reach the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof which is above the aspect of King.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
